1.w: [“] Let not your⁺ heart be troubled. You⁺ believe in God; believe also in Me.

2.w: In My Father’s house are many dwelling places. And if not so, would I have told you⁺ that I am going to prepare a place for you⁺?

3.w: And if I go and prepare a place for you⁺, I am coming again, and I will receive you⁺ to Myself, so that where I am, you⁺ may be also.

4.w: And you⁺ know the way to where I am going.”

5.w: Thomas says to Him, “Lord, we do not know where You are going; how can we know the way?”

6.w: Jesus says to him, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father if not through Me.

7.w: If you⁺ had known Me, you⁺ would also have known My Father. From now, you⁺ know Him and have seen Him.”

8.w: Philip says to Him, “Lord, show us the Father, and it is enough for us.”

9.w: Jesus says to him, “Am I with you⁺ so long a time, and you have not known Me, Philip? The one having seen Me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

10.w: Do you not believe that I [am] in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words that I speak to you⁺ I do not speak from Myself; but the Father dwelling in Me does His works.

11.w: Believe Me that I [am] in the Father and the Father [is] in Me; but if not, believe because of the works themselves.

12.w: Truly, truly, I say to you⁺, the one believing in Me, the works that I do, he will also do. And he will do greater than these, because I am going to the Father.

13.w: And whatever you⁺ might ask in My name, this I will do, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

14.w: If you⁺ ask Me anything in My name, I will do [it].

15.w: If you⁺ love Me, you⁺ will keep My commandments.

16.w: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you⁺ another Advocate so that He may be with you⁺ to the age—

17.w: the Spirit of truth, whom the world is not able to receive, because it does not see Him, nor does it know [Him]. But you⁺ know Him, for He abides with you⁺ and will be in you⁺.

18.w: I will not leave you⁺ as orphans; I am coming to you⁺.

19.w: Yet a little while, and the world sees Me no more, but you⁺ see Me. Because I live, you⁺ also will live.

20.w: In that day you⁺ will know that I [am] in My Father, and you⁺ in Me, and I in you⁺.

21.w: The one having My commandments and keeping them, he is the one loving Me. Now the one loving Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him, and I will show Myself to him.”

22.w: Judas (not Iscariot) says to Him, “Lord, then what has occurred that You are about to manifest Yourself to us and not to the world?”

23.w: Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word, and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and will make a home with him.

24.w: The one not loving Me does not keep My words. And the word that you⁺ hear is not Mine, but [that] of the Father having sent Me.

25.w: These things I have said to you⁺, remaining with you⁺.

26.w: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you⁺ all things and will remind you⁺ of all the things that I said to you⁺.

27.w: Peace I leave with you⁺; My peace I give to you⁺. Not as the world gives do I give to you⁺. Let not your⁺ heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid.

28.w: You⁺ heard that I said to you⁺, ‘I am going away and I am coming to you⁺.’ If you⁺ loved Me, you⁺ would have rejoiced that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.

29.w: And now I have told you⁺ before it comes to pass, so that when it shall have come to pass, you⁺ may believe.

30.w: No longer will I speak much with you⁺; for the ruler of the world comes, and in Me he has nothing.

31.w: But so that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded Me, thus I do. Rise up, let us go from here.[]
